AUTHOR: P. C. Naval; L. T. David
TITLE: FishDrop: Estimation of reef fish population density and biomass using stereo cameras
DATA: Own stereo GoPro transect videos, 20 sites, Verde Island Passage
V_EV: Sec. IV-A: 'The videos were obtained at different depths, times of day, and visibility conditions. An inclusion criterion of at least 10 meter visibility was imposed.'
D_EV: no statement found (Sec. III-E only: 'A collection of these images for each species are set aside for training the CNN classifier')
R_EV: Sec. IV-A: 'We measure the performance ... on 20 two-minute clips from fish videos taken from 20 different sampling sites in the Verde Island Passage'
C_EV: Sec. IV-A / Table I: 'The precision and recall values were obtained from 300 randomly selected segmented images.' (precision 0.71)
E_EV: Tables I-II report only segmentation precision/recall and CNN accuracy: 'Segmentation and classifier performances are found in Tables I and II.'
ARCH: Motion-based segmentation + stereo 3D + fine-tuned AlexNet (Caffe) classifier
NOTE: PLAT: diver-placed stationary stereo drop rig moved along transect (could be read as DOV). V: footage restricted to >=10 m visibility (P1 could argue V_ALL=N, but a numeric visibility criterion was stated, so coded V1=기타 정량, V_ALL=P mechanically); V6=P from qualitative note that performance degrades at ~5 m depth due to surface wave lensing. Density/biomass/MaxN computed by the system but never reported/evaluated -> E1=없음. 'Non-fish' class added to CNN not coded as C4. Train/test split for CNN not described. Pretraining source not stated (fine-tuned AlexNet).
